# Venture

Before doing venture work or maintaining this harness, read and follow
[the canonical agent instructions](../AGENTS.md). Resolve their paths from the
repository root.

Read the selected venture's brief, task state, and progress before continuing.
Never invent business evidence or treat a draft validation pass as completion.
Keep private venture data out of tracked repository files.

The shared instructions define startup, skill routing, verification, and
handoff. Maintain those rules there rather than duplicating them here.
